# Required DE-Art Illustration — Chunk Racer

**Folder:** `/Users/dj/Documents/Decoder/Required DE-Art illustration`  
**Project:** Decoder — Chunk Racer iOS app  
**Status:** Placeholder / concept art generated by the Apple Fellow. These assets are ready for DE-Art to replace with final production illustrations.

## What this folder contains

This folder holds the first-pass art assets needed to align Chunk Racer with the high-fidelity mockup. It is split into two categories:

### 1. AI-generated hero concepts (replace with vector/rigged final art)
- `arlo_kart_hero.png` — Arlo the bear in a teal go-kart, hero concept.
- `chunk_racer_logo_concept.png` — "CHUNK RACER" logo wordmark with orange car.

### 2. Vector-style placeholders (already in the iOS bundle)
These are `@1x`/`@2x`/`@3x` PNGs generated from the Python scripts below. They are currently bundled in the app so the UI can be tested, but they are intended as placeholders for final DE-Art.

- `racer_car_orange*` — orange race car for logo and track
- `racer_track_road*`, `racer_track_hill*`, `racer_track_tree*`, `racer_track_cloud*` — scrolling environment tiles
- `ui_button_pause*`, `ui_button_sound*`, `ui_button_skip*` — control buttons
- `ui_ruler_vertical*` — vertical reading ruler
- `arlo_smiley*` — footer guide icon (already using darker teal for AA contrast)
- `racer_car*`, `finish_flag*`, `chunk_racer_logo*` — earlier mockup-1 aligned placeholders

### 3. Generation scripts
- `generate_game_assets.py` — generates the original mockup-1 aligned placeholders (car, flag, smiley, logo).
- `generate_mockup2_placeholders.py` — generates the mockup-2 environment/UI placeholders.

Run either script from the project root to regenerate the assets:

```bash
cd "/Users/dj/Documents/Decoder"
python3 "Required DE-Art illustration/generate_game_assets.py"
python3 "Required DE-Art illustration/generate_mockup2_placeholders.py"
```

## Definition of Done for DE-Art (must be met before shipping)

Every final asset must:

- [ ] Be vector-first (SVG/PDF) or authored at the largest iPad target size with `@1x`/`@2x`/`@3x` rasters.
- [ ] Match the art-bible palette exactly:
  - Primary brand: `#2A9D8F` (teal), text variant `#1B7A6E`
  - Secondary: `#E76F51` (coral)
  - Success: `#A67C2E` (gold)
  - Gentle re-serve: `#5A8A8A`
  - Ink: `#264653`
  - Background: `#F7F4EC` / `#1A1F23`
  - Surface: `#FFFDF7` / `#2A3036`
- [ ] Have a transparent background for characters, vehicles, and props.
- [ ] Provide light and dark variants.
- [ ] Provide a Reduce-Motion variant if animated.
- [ ] Pass the contrast audit (`assets/code/contrast_audit.py`).
- [ ] Be named to its `assetKey` in `app/assets/art-bible/ASSET_KEY_MAP.md`.
- [ ] Be tone-checked: warm, never babyish, never corrective.

- `brand_logo_chunk_racer` — final vector logo with "CHUNK RACER" + orange car
- `arlo_kart_idle` / `celebrate` / `encourage` — rigged Arlo in kart poses
- `arlo_kart_dust` — motion/dust particle frames
- `environment_hill_layer1`, `environment_tree_layer2`, `environment_cloud_layer3` — parallax scrolling layers
- `racer_track_road` — final road texture with teal stripe
- `celebrate_sparkle` — refined success burst
- `ui_pill_find_chunk` — "Find the chunk!" label pill
- Final reading fonts (Fredoka One, OpenDyslexic, Lexend Deca) — these live in `app/ChunkRacerApp/Resources/Fonts/`
